title: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (August 2026)
summary: A monthly recurring Hacker News community post where tech professionals share their job search information in a standardized format (location, remote status, willingness to relocate, technologies, resume, email) to connect with potential employers directly.
problem_solved: Connects tech job seekers with potential employers through a free, community-driven platform without intermediaries like recruiters or agencies.
why_valuable: Provides a trusted, low-friction networking channel specifically for the tech community where direct employer-candidate connections can happen organically.
